info.name: Bifrost V1 - Virtual Key Rotation Cooldown
info.description: Virtual key rotation-cooldown tests. Covers the default state (cooldown never configured, so rotation revokes the old value immediately), the vk_rotation_cooldown config API (duration strings, integer nanoseconds, bounds, zero-clears), rotation semantics (single, bulk, partial failure, re-rotation overwrite), and runtime grace-window enforcement across /v1/chat/completions, /v1/models, and the self-service quota endpoint at 1m and 3m windows. The 3m window opens first so both waits overlap. Config PUTs are read-modify-write of a snapshot taken in Setup and restored in Teardown; intended for fresh e2e environments where client_config carries no redacted secret-bearing fields. Also covers immediate revocation when the cooldown is emptied or zero (an empty duration string is accepted as 'no cooldown'): re-rotating a key that holds a live grace value kills both retired values at once on inference and quota. Self-provisions VKs and cleans up. Wall clock: roughly 4 minutes (dominated by the 1m and 3m grace windows).
